# adjudicate

> Guardrails for AI agents: a deterministic control layer between LLM tool-calls and execution. Every state-mutating AI action crosses the kernel as an IntentEnvelope and is adjudicated to one of six outcomes — execute, refuse, rewrite, defer, escalate, request-confirmation — and recorded as a tamper-evident, replay-verifiable audit receipt (with an optional cryptographic signature for non-repudiation).

## Pages

- [Home](/): What adjudicate is and why six outcomes beat allow/deny.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): The kernel mechanism, end to end.
- [Capabilities](/capabilities): The fourteen things the kernel does, each mapped to a real package and ADR.
- [Deploy](/deploy): Run the kernel in your own infrastructure.
- [Console](/console): The operator console — decisions, approvals, audit explorer, governance surfaces.
- [Playground](/playground): Run the real kernel against an intent and see the decision.
- [Architecture: data flow](/architecture/data-flow): How an intent travels from AI to side-effect.
- [Comparisons](/comparisons): Where six decisions beat binary allow/deny.
- [Transparency](/transparency): Public trust hub — PII handling, AI-BOM, drift, red-team posture.
- [Blog](/blog): Engineering and design notes from the kernel.

## Install

- `pnpm add @adjudicate/core` — the published, API-stable v1 kernel (additive-only).
- Adapters: `@adjudicate/anthropic`, `@adjudicate/openai`.
- Packs: `@adjudicate/pack-*`. CLI: `@adjudicate/cli`.
